title: Resource and startup signatures
summary: 53300 indicates excessive connections; 53100 disk full; 53200 insufficient memory; 57P03 cannot connect now. Connection errors may lack a driver SQLSTATE, leaving authentication, TLS, routing and startup unresolved.
checks: Check declared listener, ordinary-slot headroom and relevant storage.
limitations: A server error does not identify the initiating cause.
